name: Clair
description:
Level 7 Highlighted Blonde

100% Brazilian Remy human hair with a natural root, Level 7 base, and bright Level 10 highlights blended throughout for a soft, dimensional finish.

The natural root keeps the color looking seamless and lived in, while the lighter highlights add brightness, contrast, and beautiful dimension.

Because this is 100% human hair, treat and style her just like your natural hair. She arrives professionally colored and styled, but shipping may affect the finished look, so you may want to restyle her to your preference after unboxing.
